about: Every time a vehicle in this project's lineage was in water, and what that does and does not prove about the code here today. Read by tools/ci/gen_lineage.py (which writes lineage.md) and by test/test_water_claims_have_a_scope.py. A status is earned by the evidence listed with it, never inherited: code that descends from a water-tested predecessor has its own status, in docs/capability-map.md.

statuses.HISTORICAL_WATER: in water, on an earlier vehicle, firmware or stack than the current platform
statuses.RECORDED_WATER_REPLAY: real underwater footage, recorded on an earlier vehicle, replayed through the current code
statuses.CURRENT_WATER: in water on the current platform, with a recorded artifact in this repository
statuses.NOT_YET: the current platform has not been in water

platforms.duburi-2025: the university programme's vehicle at RoboSub 2025: Pixhawk and ArduSub, the author's vision stack (not in this repository)
platforms.duburi-2026: the same programme's vehicle at RoboSub 2026: Pixhawk and ArduSub, running the Duburi ROS 2 stack this repository's history begins with
platforms.dubomini-srot: the old Dubomini hull (eight vectored T200s) with the SROT board and Hengla firmware, driven by the firmware team's own tools
platforms.mongla-srot-kutum: the current platform: this stack on the SROT board and the Kutum Pi 5 with a Hailo-8, in the Mongla hull

events.observed: The SROT board closed its depth loop in DEPTH_HOLD; it bounced at DEPTH_P 3.0 and was tuned in water to P 0.5, I 0.1, D 0.01. A DEPTH_HOLD to AUTO transition crashed the board. Every axis ran reversed until the firmware gained FRAME_REVERSE.
events.code_in_water: Hengla firmware and the firmware team's tools. None of this stack ran.
events.code_identity: firmware commits 09d0033 and f533bd2 on srot-control-board

evidence.note: the firmware team's in-water source record

events.active_today: the board, and the depth gains it was tuned to; AUTO, which every move verb uses, has not been in water
